AACTIVATED Rx app

This is the app running live. Tap through it the way a patient, rep or clinic would.

  1. Pick Patient, Member / Rep or Clinic.
  2. Use the tabs at the bottom.
  3. Switch views anytime in Account.

Portal and "Start my intake" buttons open the live site or portal in a new tab. In the iPhone and Android app they open inside the app.

This preview shows the full catalog (web app version). The App Store and Google Play version hides the web-only products and the Founders link. On a phone, open this link for a full-screen version.
